newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Diamonds go unnoticed in Swissair cargo centre.
newsitem.headline: Diamonds go unnoticed in Swissair cargo centre.

text.p: Raw diamonds worth $11 million lay unnoticed for two hours in a freight container thought to be empty in a Swissair freight room at Zurich airport, the Swiss airline said on Friday.
Swissair said a cargo handler discovered the shipment from Zaire and bound for London when he opened the metal container, intending to use it for luggage headed for Atlanta.

A Swissair spokesman said the sacks went unnoticed because a telex message alerting the Zurich cargo service about the incoming shipment never arrived from Kinshasa, where the diamonds were flown out by Swissair.

"Normally a message is sent and valuable cargo is escorted to a special freight room...We assume the telex advisory never reached Zurich because of the troubles in Zaire," spokesman Herbert Schmell said.
Schmell confirmed a Swiss newspaper report that the cargo worker who found and turned over the diamonds was given a reward by his boss -- 50 Swiss francs from the boss's own pocket.
